class Box {
  #value = 3;
  static #tag = 5;
  static read(value: Box | { other: number }) {
    if (#value in value) return value.#value;
    return value.other;
  }
  static readTag(value: object) {
    if (#tag in value) return value.#tag;
    return 0;
  }
  read() { return this.#value; }
}
class SubBox extends Box {}
class Other {
  "#value": "public" = "public";
}
const joined = Object.assign(new Box(), new Other());

class PrivateTagA {
  #tag: "a" = "a";
  a() { return this.#tag; }
}
class PrivateTagB {
  #tag: "b" = "b";
  b = "b";
}
const separate = Object.assign(new PrivateTagA(), new PrivateTagB());

class Dict {
  [key: string]: number;
  #value = "private";
  count = 1;
}
class PatternDict {
  [key: `#${string}`]: number;
  #value = "private";
  "#public" = 2;
}
let field: 0 | 1 = 0;
let method: 1 | "method" = 1;
let accessor: 2 | "accessor" = 2;
class Field {
  [field] = 10;
}
class Method {
  [method]() { return 20; }
}
class Accessor {
  get [accessor]() { return 30; }
}
field = 1;
method = "method";
accessor = "accessor";
const fieldKey: keyof Field = 0;
const methodKey: keyof Method = 1;
const accessorKey: keyof Accessor = 2;

console.log(Box.read(new SubBox()), Box.read({ other: 4 }), Box.readTag(Box), Box.readTag(SubBox));
console.log(joined.read(), joined["#value"], separate.a(), separate.b);
console.log(new Dict().count, new PatternDict()["#public"], new Field()[fieldKey], Object.hasOwn(Method.prototype, methodKey), new Accessor()[accessorKey]);
